units.source_text: “可不是嘛，要不是到这儿来，阿雪也许早就是个艺伎了。”

en.t: That's right. If she had not come here, Ayuki might already have become a geisha.

units.source_text: 仓吉背靠古老的漆木五屉柜坐着，双手抱住支起的那条腿的膝盖。

en.t: Kurayoshi sat with his back against an old five-drawer lacquered cabinet, holding the knee of his raised leg in both hands.
